title: Vertex Depth Under Appending Gates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $gs$ and $ext$ be finite lists of gates. For every natural-number vertex index $v<n+|gs|$, the depth assigned to $v$ after processing $gs$ followed by $ext$, starting with $n$ input vertices of depth zero, equals its depth after processing $gs$ alone.
hypotheses_covered: $gs$ and $ext$ are finite lists of gates
